results.question: How long after signing can a draft rookie be traded?
results.answer: A Draft Rookie who signs a Standard NBA Contract cannot be traded before thirty (30) days following the date on which the contract is signed [Article VII, Section 8(d)].

results.question: How long after signing can a free agent be traded?
results.answer:
A player who signs a Standard NBA Contract as a Free Agent generally cannot be traded before the later of:
* Three (3) months following the date the contract was signed, or 
* The December 15 of the Salary Cap Year in which the contract was signed [Article VII, Section 8(d)(ii)]. 
*(This waiting period does not apply to the initial trade if the contract is signed in connection with an agreement to trade the contract under Section 8(e)) [Article VII, Section 8(d)(ii)].*

However, the player cannot be traded before the later of three (3) months following the signing date or January 15 of that Salary Cap Year if all of the following criteria are met:
* The player re-signs a Standard NBA Contract with their prior Team [Article VII, Section 8(d)(iii)];
* The team's Team Salary is above the Salary Cap immediately following the signing [Article VII, Section 8(d)(iii)]; and
* The player is a Qualifying Veteran Free Agent or Early Qualifying Veteran Free Agent who signs for a first-season Salary greater than one hundred twenty percent (120%) of the Salary for the last Season of their immediately prior Contract [Article VII, Section 8(d)(iii)].

results.question: How often can a team use the Bi-annual Exception?
results.answer: A team cannot use all or any portion of the Bi-annual Exception in any two (2) consecutive Salary Cap Years [Article VII, Section 6(d)(3)].

results.question: How long can a Bi-annual Exception contract be?
results.answer: A Player Contract signed pursuant to the Bi-annual Exception may not exceed two (2) Seasons in length [Article VII, Section 6(d)(2)]. Additionally, the remaining term of a contract acquired by assignment pursuant to the Bi-annual Exception may not exceed two (2) Seasons in length [Article VII, Section 6(d)(2)].

results.question: How long can a Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level contract be?
results.answer: A Player Contract signed or acquired by assignment pursuant to the Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception may not exceed four (4) Seasons in length [Article VII, Section 6(e)(2)].

results.question: Can a team above the second apron aggregate player salaries in a trade?
results.answer: No. Acquiring a player in a trade using the Aggregated Standard Traded Player Exception is prohibited if, immediately following the trade, the team's Apron Team Salary would exceed the Second Apron Level [Article VII, Section 2(e)(5)].
